phase: Final: deterministic external-dependency audit/gate aggregating the 5 ROADMAP items that require human data or real provider credentials. All 5 parent items REMAIN UNCHECKED; only the audit/gate scaffold is delivered and marked as a checked sub-note.
summary: Added build_external_dependency_audit(config=None): a deterministic, stdlib-only capstone that aggregates the five still-unchecked real-world blockers (real query set, real-query BM25 calibration, real embedding provider + persistent vector store + production index, real reranker/cross-encoder + RRF, real NLI/LLM semantic conflict) into one machine-readable report. Each blocker names its ROADMAP line/topic, required external input, current repo state, and the readiness scaffold/gate protecting it. all_external_dependencies_satisfied is false by default; roadmap_parent_items_checked is always false. A blocker is 'satisfied' only when config declares an artifact whose METADATA SHAPE passes the matching readiness helper (summarize_real_query_readiness=='ready_real' or *_readiness.production_ready==true) — declared-metadata shape only, never credential read, provider contact, or evaluation. A CLI tools/check_external_dependency_audit.py exits 1 in the default repo state. No dataset/connectivity/metric/credential/model-download/eval result is fabricated.

risks: all_external_dependencies_satisfied=true is a CONFIG-COMPLETENESS aggregate, not a connectivity/authentication/evaluation check; a fully-declared but wrong config would read as satisfied. It informs a human decision and never auto-checks a ROADMAP parent.
The audit only checks artifacts explicitly named under config.artifacts; it does not scan the filesystem or discover real datasets/providers on its own.
It reuses the same readiness helpers as the individual scaffolds, so its verdict is exactly as strict (and as metadata-only) as they are — if one is loosened, this aggregate loosens with it.
It deliberately never resolves credential_source to a secret and never contacts a provider, so it cannot confirm a credential is valid or a model is reachable.

Environment note: the local interpreter is python3 (no bare 'python' on PATH); the quality-gate runner honors PYTHON=python3, and a local 'python->python3' PATH shim lets its default-interpreter meta-test pass.
credentials: No credentials or .env files were read, created, or modified; the audit resolves no credential_source to a secret and reuses validators that reject credential-shaped fields.
No external network calls, provider calls, model downloads, or dataset fabrication were used for implementation or local tests.
